title: Zestimate Trend Baseline Drift
dataSources: Mortgage-rate snapshots (`mortgage:rate`), property-listing and Zestimate data (`property:listing`), HOA fees (`hoa:fee`), property-tax installments (`propertytax:installment`), home-buying milestones (`homebuying:milestone`).
app: Mortgage-rate watchers, Zestimate exports, HOA-fee logs, and property-tax installment trackers streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and personal checklists.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=property:listing
| eventstats avg(zestimate_usd) as base, stdev(zestimate_usd) as sd
| eval delta=round(zestimate_usd-base,2)
| where abs(delta)>2*sd
| table _time zip_code zestimate_usd delta
| sort - _time
description: Highlights unusually large movement in zestimate trend compared with its own baseline.
value: Baseline drift helps you see when a signal stopped behaving like background noise and started becoming decision-worthy.
implementation: Use this with a few months of history so the baseline is meaningful rather than fragile.
visualization: Table of outlier zestimate trend records and delta from baseline.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces when zestimate trend moves much more than usual.
